qp_model_provenance.google_data_role: guide for broad event scales only; no Sycamore coordinate correction or per-event matching
qp_model_provenance.generation_prior_selection: synthetic non-saturation check only; 128 generated events, no real syndrome outcomes used
qp_model_provenance.generation_quantity: local QP-generation density proxy sampled at each qubit coordinate; summing over qubits is not deposited energy
qp_model_provenance.energy_conservation_scope: not modeled; required only for particle-energy, dose, material, or chip-geometry prediction
qp_model_provenance.hardware_semantics: one persistent 100 us / 200 us / 5 GHz reference device and per-qubit calibration map is sampled once; run/event hardware drift is disabled
qp_model_provenance.reference_hardware: Baity et al., arXiv:2602.06202; replace with measured calibration for a target device
qp_model_provenance.intended_use: phenomenological superconducting-QEC stress-test data generation and sensitivity studies; not absolute hardware prediction

settings.split: 24 train / 8 validation / 8 test cycles of 36 balanced strata
settings.exclusion: strong elliptical conjunction excluded from training and validation selection
settings.region_labels: relative to d3 reference box, not each larger code
settings.inference: detector events only; REI also receives fixed layout coordinates
settings.paired: one physical simulation on union coordinates; circuits use identical fields at shared coordinates; independent circuit sampling seeds
settings.scope: fixed pitch, expanding coverage; not fixed-area denser sensing; no-event and detection latency not evaluated
settings.feature_cut: median training onset, fixed at inference
settings.selection: ordinary validation mean Euclidean error; all distances frozen before test evaluation
settings.bootstrap: 10000 paired event resamples, descriptive 95% intervals, no multiplicity correction

split: new 72 train cycles, 12 validation cycles, 12 test cycles; 36 balanced strata per cycle
nested: 720 original ordinary training events + first 24/72 new train cycles for 1440/2880
exclusion: strong ellipses excluded from fitting and validation selection; all old validation/test excluded from training
primary: fixed old-selected SVR + ExtraTrees settings, coordinate mean; compare n2880 minus n720 on ordinary new test
secondary: equal validation search budgets per size: Ridge/SVR/ExtraTrees, blend, 3-seed CNN
test: fresh 432 physical events: 360 ordinary + 72 strong ellipses; weak 144; two shots/event
features: same inherited cut and independent quiet calibration for all sizes; scalers fitted only on training subset
